coaching_tip: When a customer gives a clear 20-35 g range and nothing in stock fits, open with the made-to-order option at her weight before showing out-of-range pieces, so she hears the solution before she gets tired of looking.
flags: objection 'other': customer declined to wait about ten days for a made-to-order piece

'look around elsewhere' at 01:33 names no shop, so competitor is null
